query: I filed my GSTR-3B for October 2023 with a delay of 20 days. My tax liability was NIL. What is the late fee?
expected_logic: Since tax liability is NIL, late fee is Rs. 20 per day (Rs. 10 CGST + Rs. 10 SGST), subject to a maximum of Rs. 500.

query: I claimed excess ITC of Rs. 1 Lakh in Jan but reversed it in Feb without utilizing it. Do I need to pay interest under Section 50?
expected_logic: Interest under Section 50(3) is applicable only when ITC is availed AND utilized. Since it was not utilized, no interest is payable per Rule 88B.

query: My consignment value is Rs. 60,000 including exempt goods of Rs. 20,000. Is E-way bill mandatory for intra-state movement?
expected_logic: Consignment value for E-Way Bill excludes exempt goods. Taxable value = 60k - 20k = 40k. Since 40k < 50k threshold, E-Way Bill is NOT mandatory.

query: I am a service provider in Telangana with turnover of 18 Lakhs. Do I need to register?
expected_logic: Threshold for service providers in Telangana (Normal State) is Rs. 20 Lakhs. Since 18L < 20L, registration is not required.

query: I collected tax of Rs. 2 Lakhs but failed to pay it to the government for 4 months. What is the penalty under Section 122?
expected_logic: Penalty is strictly 100% of tax (Rs. 2 Lakhs) OR Rs. 10,000, whichever is higher. So penalty is Rs. 2 Lakhs.

query: Can I claim ITC on food and beverages provided to employees in the office canteen?
expected_logic: ITC on food and beverages is blocked under Section 17(5) unless it is obligatory under any law.

query: I received legal services from an advocate. Who is liable to pay GST under reverse charge?
expected_logic: GST on legal services by advocates is payable by the recipient (business entity) under reverse charge as per Section 9(3).

query: I received an advance of Rs. 5 Lakhs for supply of goods in March but supplied goods in April. When is time of supply?
expected_logic: For goods, time of supply is date of invoice or last date of issue of invoice as per Section 12. Advance receipt does not trigger time of supply for goods.

query: I am a manufacturer with turnover of Rs. 1.2 Crore. Can I opt for composition scheme and what will be my tax rate?
expected_logic: Composition scheme is available for manufacturers with turnover up to Rs. 1.5 Crore under Section 10. Rate is 1% (0.5% CGST + 0.5% SGST).

query: I am in Delhi and providing IT services to a client in Mumbai. What is the place of supply?
expected_logic: For B2B services, place of supply is the location of recipient (Mumbai). Since supplier is in Delhi and recipient in Mumbai, it is inter-state supply attracting IGST.

query: I exported goods with payment of IGST. How do I claim refund of IGST paid?
expected_logic: Refund of IGST on exports can be claimed under Section 54 by filing in GSTR-1/3B. Shipping bill is treated as refund application. Time limit is 2 years from relevant date.

query: The tax officer issued a show cause notice under Section 73 for short payment of tax. What is the time limit for adjudication?
expected_logic: Under Section 73 (non-fraud cases), the time limit for issuing order is 3 years from the due date of annual return.

query: I want to appeal against an order of adjudicating authority. What is the time limit and pre-deposit requirement?
expected_logic: Appeal to Appellate Authority under Section 107 must be filed within 3 months (extendable by 1 month). Pre-deposit of 10% of disputed tax is required.

query: Are educational services provided by a government-recognized school exempt from GST?
expected_logic: Services provided by educational institutions to students up to higher secondary level are exempt from GST.

query: A government department is making a payment of Rs. 3 Lakhs to a contractor. Is TDS under GST applicable?
expected_logic: TDS under Section 51 is applicable as payment exceeds Rs. 2.5 Lakhs. Rate is 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST) for intra-state supply.

query: What is the due date for filing GSTR-9 annual return and is it mandatory for all taxpayers?
expected_logic: GSTR-9 is due on 31st December of next financial year under Section 44. It is mandatory for all regular taxpayers with turnover above Rs. 2 Crore.

query: I am providing services to a related person without consideration. How should the value be determined for GST?
expected_logic: Supply to related persons is taxable even without consideration (Schedule I). Value to be determined as per Rule 28 - open market value or comparable value.

query: I issued a credit note in November for a supply made in June of the same financial year. What is the last date to declare this credit note in returns?
expected_logic: Credit note must be declared in returns by 30th November of next financial year or date of filing annual return, whichever is earlier, as per Section 34.

query: I sent goods to a job worker 2 years ago. What is the time limit to receive back the goods?
expected_logic: Inputs must be returned within 1 year and capital goods within 3 years from the date of sending, as per Section 143.

query: What is the minimum number of digits of HSN code required on invoices for a business with turnover of Rs. 6 Crore?
expected_logic: For turnover above Rs. 5 Crore, 6-digit HSN code is mandatory on invoices as per the latest notification.
